quest.title: Temporary Acclimatization
quest.description: The hydrologist Woliu seems distressed about something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: The flow of water is good, and the conditions of the waters in the surrounding areas are quite satisfactory as well... This is great.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: I should still keep an eye on the surrounding soil environment, though. Looks like I'll have to place a few more instruments...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did something happen here?

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Ah, are you the Traveler? Could you spare a moment? I could really... use a favor from you.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Please allow me to introduce myself first. I'm Woliu, a hydrologist. I'm currently conducting some investigations in Chenyu Vale for research purposes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why would a hydrologist need to keep an eye on the soil environment?

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: That's a very good question. The short answer is that the study of hydrology concerns more than just the movement of water.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: The mountainous terrain, the flow of the streams, the geology of the land, the weather of the area, and even the daily lives of the human residents who call this place their home... they all affect the hydrology of the vale.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: P—Paimon can't say she really understands, but that definitely sounds super complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: It is indeed quite complicated. Still, conducting research here is far easier than conducting research in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: I kept running into all kinds of problems trying to place even a single hydrology device in Fontaine. They'd get attacked by the aquatic wildlife one day, and be swept away by the currents the next...

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: And that's not even going into all of those underwater mechanical things that archons-know-who placed down there... Ugh, just remembering all of this is giving me a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the favor you'd like to ask of us...

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Ah, that... Well, it's really a small thing. I'd like to request that you help me place these monitoring instruments on that mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: I have just ordered these mechanical instruments from Fontaine. Once placed, they will continuously bore down through the earth until they've obtained the deep soil samples that I require.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: With those samples, I'll be able to measure the influence the local hydrology has had on the soil quality of the nearby mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds straightforward enough.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: If that's... what you think. I've been meaning to hire a few adventurers for the task, but no one has accepted my commission so far, and I've heard that there are a lot of Treasure Hoarders in the area...

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: But judging from your looks, you're not at all scared of those bullies, are you?

response.speaker: Woliu
response.text: Then, I leave the placement of the instruments to you. All you need is to place them on the nearby hill.

response.speaker: Woliu
response.text: I still need to stay here to adjust some more instruments. Just come back to me once you've placed the batch that I've given you.

choices.text: If they're smart, they should be scared of me.

talks.objective: Help Woliu set up the device

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: D—Don't look down! It's so high up here. Let's just get out of here once we've placed the instruments!

talks.objective: Help Woliu set up the device

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Would this place do? Ah well, let's just trust that this device will do its job.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: That position right up ahead looks quite promising... Hmm... Maybe I'll take a look by the drawbridge in a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: ...These adjustments ought to do it.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Ah, have you placed the instruments already? Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Once I'm done placing this one, I'll give you your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could have just given it to me alongside the rest of the batch.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Thank you for your kindness. Unfortunately, this instrument is somewhat special. It requires some additional adjustments and calibrating, and I wouldn't want to trouble you that much.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Let's go to that cliff over there and place it, then I'll give you your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds really hard... Have you always worked like this?

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Haha, at least now, I only need to place my instruments down on the ground. In a previous expedition, I actually had to figure out a way to place one in the middle of a raging river...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Couldn't you just take a boat over there?

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: I mean, if all I needed to do was to drop the instrument, then sure, I could have just taken a boat, dropped it in the middle of the river, and left...

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: But I was trying to measure the intensity of the water flow, so I had to keep that specialized instrument stationary within the heart of the stream so that it would neither float to the top nor sink to the bottom...

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Thankfully, there was a drawbridge above that river. Had there not been a bridge, I'd have had to ask some people to help me draw a rope between the two mountains...

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: And then hang the device onto one of the ropes, before using another rope to move it to the center of the river and drop it in the water.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Anyway... There's no point talking about that now. It's not like that's something we'll have to deal with... That said, we'll still pass by a drawbridge on our way to our destination.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Come this way. That drawbridge isn't far from here.

talks.objective: Speak with the person who just escaped

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After chasing away the Treasure Hoarders, you bring the people they cornered to a nearby pavilion to catch their breath.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: Thank you, I really don't know how to express my gratitude...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are... Ms. Qiu?

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: #Ah... It's you, {NICKNAME}! Well, fancy running into you again! This is really... This is the second time that you've done me such a huge favor!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Weren't you guys in Fontaine learning how to shoot a film? How are you already back in Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you already mastered the art of filmmaking?

dialogues.speaker: Yifeng
dialogues.text: Well, rather than that...

dialogues.speaker: Xingye
dialogues.text: It'd probably be more accurate to say we've been forced to make some quick Mora first.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: You two...

dialogues.speaker: Yifeng
dialogues.text: Mr. Geisert is indeed a master filmmaker, and he's given us a lot of very useful advice. However...

dialogues.speaker: Xingye
dialogues.text: The films that he's helped us shoot have all really focused on big ideas and themes. As for the actual plot, or the world and things that were intended to be featured...

dialogues.speaker: Yifeng
dialogues.text: They kind of... In Mr. Geisert's words, they were "left behind the scenes."

dialogues.speaker: Xingye
dialogues.text: But we had looked into filmmaking in the first place to create a film that could bring attention to Chenyu Vale's excellent teas. If we had stayed with Mr. Geisert, we would have gone nowhere. So...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: So! I made the executive decision to put a pause on our studies and come back to shoot a documentary. We will use this opportunity to put our knowledge to the test!

dialogues.speaker: Yifeng
dialogues.text: ...Well, and because we'd just about run out of funds.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: H—Hey, haven't I told you about my plan already? As long as this documentary becomes a smash hit, we'll make our investment back in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Yifeng
dialogues.text: #Well, and then we found ourselves cornered by Treasure Hoarders on a drawbridge. Thankfully, the great {NICKNAME} came to save us.

choices.text: Isn't this place... a bit far from Qiaoying Village?

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: *sigh* Well, I wanted to get some majestic shots of the scenery, so the film would look a bit more imposing...

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: But we got a bit too distracted while shooting and caught the attention of those Treasure Hoarders. We fled all the way here but were still cornered by them in the end...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so the "pro photographers" Woliu mentioned earlier were...

response.speaker: Woliu
response.text: Yep, they were Ms. Qiu and her assistants.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Wh—Where did you suddenly just pop up from, Ms. Woliu? I—I swear I didn't see you at all before now...

response.speaker: Woliu
response.text: I just hid myself very well.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you already know each other...

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: I mean, Ms. Woliu is an expert hydrologist. No one knows these lands better than her.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: We'd consulted her several times before this on the best places to shoot.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: We've even tried to get her to join us! But she said that she could only consider once she's finished with her work.

response.speaker: Yifeng
response.text: Boss, um... While we were running away earlier, we seemed to have, um, left the case containing our film and equipment on the ground...

response.speaker: Xingye
response.text: I think... All the work that we've done so far is in that case...

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: #Ms. Woliu! {NICKNAME}! Paimon! Thank you for everything! Wh—When you are next free, please find me in Qiaoying Village!

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: After all... You've saved our lives, so we've got to prepare a reward in return!

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: But for now, we must be off and away! Hurry! Where did we leave that box!? We need to go back for it!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Ms. Qiu and her assistants leave in a great hurry...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That film case... sure has gone through a lot...

response.speaker: Woliu
response.text: They say that good things often come at the end of many tribulations. I'm sure Ms. Qiu's film will turn out to be a hit.

response.speaker: Woliu
response.text: Anyway, let me give you your reward. I'll go place my final instrument shortly, and then... probably go check on Ms. Qiu to see how she's doing.

response.speaker: Woliu
response.text: I've got to find her fast, or she'll probably be off archon-knows-where again, shooting her film.

response.speaker: Woliu
response.text: Hmm, I suppose she did just say that she can be found at Qiaoying Village. I'll just go check that out later.

choices.text: But why are you here if you want to photograph Qiaoying Village?

talks.objective: Go to Qiaoying Village and look for Ms. Qiu

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Qiu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe we should've grabbed the Qiaoying Village shots first after all...

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! Thanks to you, we were able to save all of our stuff.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: I suppose, though, that if we were to ever return to that area in the future, we shall have to bring a few adventurers with us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, um, about your feature film on tea... How is the shooting for that going?

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Well... We've currently got...

response.speaker: Xingye
response.text: A good opening sequence.

response.speaker: Yifeng
response.text: And a good artistic vision.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So... you haven't shot much at all!?

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Well, you see... We're currently a little short on money. As a master filmmaker, Mr. Geisert's tuition doesn't exactly come cheap...

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Even though we've already shot a few smaller films, and made some Mora from that, a feature film of this length just burns through your budget as if it's nothing.

response.speaker: Xingye
response.text: Especially since Boss also turned down a few potential sponsors.

response.speaker: Yifeng
response.text: And refused many invitations to collaborate.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Hey, what do you two know!? This was all so that we can create an excellent film that reflects our standards and our vision!

response.speaker: Xingye
response.text: But Boss... Didn't we start this film company because we wanted to make money...

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: I... Stop worrying about that for now! Just go and set up the equipment!

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, this is your reward. Thank you for always lending me your support.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Once I've made the film of my dreams, I'll be sure to invite you over for the premiere, and then also take you out for tea.

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: Yifeng, Xingye, make sure you get the best angle for our lighting! We're gonna get this in one take, you hear me?

response.speaker: Xingye
response.text: But Boss, we don't even have any actors here with us...

response.speaker: Yifeng
response.text: Isn't it all up to chance whether or not we can grab a scenery shot in one take...?

response.speaker: Ms. Qiu
response.text: J—Just hurry up and set up the equipment! And then wait here!

choices.text: Looks like you didn't lose any equipment, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: I hope Ms. Qiu will be able to shoot the film of her dreams while ensuring her personal safety.
Help! Is anyone there? Help!

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: Hmm... It should be over this way. The scenery here is quite excellent, so we can take our time.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: A lot of professional photographers came here to record the scenery during the "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" photography competition not too long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Woliu
dialogues.text: You'll be able to get a great view of the surrounding vistas from on top of the bridge.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that should be enough! Let's go back and find Woliu. It's not every day that we just get a simple commission like this, hehe. Easy-peasy, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After chasing away the Treasure Hoarders, you bring the people they cornered to a nearby pavilion to catch their breath.
